clauses.evidence: [activate [0] from battlefield]: 'card becomes tapped (by card/TAP)', then 'card moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE)'. [play land] is an ordinary land drop

clauses.clause: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
clauses.evidence: The probe library holds no basic land, so the activation fetches nothing. Pack three_lands_stays_tapped: the basic Forest enters tapped, the nonbasic Bloodfell Caves stays in the library (pass). The shuffle cannot be observed (not journalled)
clauses.issue: Tree note, no behaviour difference: the SEARCH selector is ONE_OF where the compiler's B5c-cost-sacrifice-search emits CHOOSE. For a count-1 search both resolve to one chosen candidate (selectors.py resolve_selector), so neither is stronger than printed.

clauses.clause: Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land.
clauses.evidence: Conditional(CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 4 Land) -> UNTAP(referent='result'), the same as the B5c-then-if-lands-untap template. Pack four_lands_untaps: three other lands plus the Forest -> untapped (pass). Pack three_lands_stays_tapped: two other lands plus the Forest, with five opponent lands that must not count -> stays tapped (pass)
